AF_METAL.description:
Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly.

Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station <STELLAR>Scrap Dealer<> may find this interesting...
AF_METAL.name: Tainted Metal
AF_METAL.subtitle: Salvaged Scrap

ALLOY1.description:
A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from <EARTH>Paraffinium<> and <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<>.

In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.
ALLOY1.name: Aronium
ALLOY1.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY2.description:
A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour.

Crafted from <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<> and <EARTH>Pyrite<>.
ALLOY2.name: Dirty Bronze
ALLOY2.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY3.description:
Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Ammonia<>.

Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.
ALLOY3.name: Herox
ALLOY3.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY4.description:
Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<> and <EARTH>Uranium<>.

Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.
ALLOY4.name: Lemmium
ALLOY4.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY5.description:
Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Phosphorus<>.

Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.
ALLOY5.name: Magno-Gold
ALLOY5.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY6.description:
Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Dioxite<>.

A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.
ALLOY6.name: Grantine
ALLOY6.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY7.description:
Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.

Crafted from <SPECIAL>Herox<>, <SPECIAL>Dirty Bronze<> and <SPECIAL>Lemmium<>.
ALLOY7.name: Geodesite
ALLOY7.subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal

ALLOY8.description:
Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields.

Crafted from <SPECIAL>Aronium<>, <SPECIAL>Magno-Gold<> and <SPECIAL>Grantine<>.
ALLOY8.name: Iridesite
ALLOY8.subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal

ANY_BONE.description:
A highly refined food product, created in the <TECHNOLOGY>Nutrient Processor<>. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets.

Food such as this can be <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.

ANY_BONE.subtitle: Ingredient Category

ANY_FISH.description:

Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.

ASTEROID1.description:
Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically <COMMODITY>mined from asteroids<>. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Prized by people in all systems for its lustre and shine.
ASTEROID1.name: Silver
ASTEROID1.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral

ASTEROID2.description:
Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically <COMMODITY>mined from asteroids<>. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Universally prized for its beauty and versatility.
ASTEROID2.name: Gold
ASTEROID2.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral

ASTEROID3.description:
Extremely valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically <COMMODITY>mined from asteroids<>. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Universally prized for its hardiness and versatility.
ASTEROID3.name: Platinum
ASTEROID3.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral

BAIT_BASIC.description: Basic creature bait<>. Can be placed directly or accessed via the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>). This bait will attract creatures and cause them to yield Faecium<>. Once a creature has been fed, they may be tamed<> or farmed<> for their produce. Dropping bait may calm angry<> creatures.
BAIT_BASIC.name: Creature Pellets
BAIT_BASIC.subtitle: Compressed Nutrients

BAIT_VEG_1.description: A specialist bait<> for herbivores<>. Use the Analysis Visor<> to discover the bait preferences of specific creatures. Created in a Nutrient Processor<> from Faecium<> and harvestable plants<>. Can be further processed in the Nutrient Processor<> to create new bait types<>. Feeding using the correct bait will allow creatures to be ridden<> or harvested<>. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
BAIT_VEG_1.name: Scented Herbs
BAIT_VEG_1.subtitle: Herbivore Bait

BLUE2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Indium is found on planets orbiting <TECHNOLOGY>blue stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
BLUE2.name: Indium
BLUE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Blue

BP_SALVAGE.description:
The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form.

These databanks can be spent at a <TECHNOLOGY>Construction Research Unit<> and used to research new <STELLAR>Construction Blueprints<>.
BP_SALVAGE.name: Salvaged Data
BP_SALVAGE.subtitle: Salvaged Technology

CATALYST1.description:
A powerful <CATALYST>catalyst<>, useful for charging <COMMODITY>defensive technologies<> such as shields or hazard protection.
 
Exosuit material handling technology allows automatic harvesting from appropriate <CATALYST<>sodium-rich flora<>.

A vital ingredient in the creation of many advanced devices, products and components.
CATALYST1.name: Sodium
CATALYST1.subtitle: Unrefined Catalytic Element

CATALYST2.description:
An <CATALYST>advanced catalyst<>, useful for charging <COMMODITY>defensive technologies<> such as shields or hazard protection.
 
Created in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>, or occasionally found in crystalline form on a planet's surface.

Offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio over regular Sodium.
CATALYST2.name: Sodium Nitrate
CATALYST2.subtitle: Refined Catalytic Element

CAVE1.description:
Mined from <TECHNOLOGY>underground minerals<>, cobalt is found in plentiful supply in caves and caverns. Useful in the manufacture of <COMMODITY>Ion Batteries<>.

It is used in the creation of several technologies and structures, and can be processed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to make the most of its inherent charge.
CAVE1.name: Cobalt
CAVE1.subtitle: Subterranean Mineral

CAVE2.description:
A highly energised form of <TECHNOLOGY>Cobalt<>, this processed metal can be used to create <COMMODITY>Advanced Ion Batteries<>, a conveniently portable source of energy for the <TECHNOLOGY>Exosuit<>.

In widespread use as a key component in the creation of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies and structures<>.
CAVE2.name: Ionised Cobalt
CAVE2.subtitle: Processed Subterranean Mineral

CLAMPEARL.description:
Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater.

Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.
CLAMPEARL.name: Living Pearl
CLAMPEARL.subtitle: Semi-Conscious Gemstone

COLD1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <TECHNOLOGY>frozen environment<>.
COLD1.name: Dioxite
COLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

CREATURE1.description:
Despite much study, little is known about this haunting, crystalline compound.

It is released from the cadavers of dying creatures, but can also be specifically <TRADEABLE>cultivated<> and harvested from the <SPECIAL>Mordite Root<> plant.
CREATURE1.name: Mordite
CREATURE1.subtitle: Harvested Substance

DRONE_SALVAGE.description:
A pane of watchful <SPECIAL>g l a s s<>, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's <TECHNOLOGY>Dissonance Resonators<>. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings.

Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key <TECHNOLOGY>Sentinel ship technologies<>.
DRONE_SALVAGE.name: Inverted Mirror
DRONE_SALVAGE.subtitle: Burning Glassy Remnant

DRONE_SHARD.description:
A fragment of glassy lifeforce, chipped from a larger formation. Dynamic intermolecular binding gives the shard a strangely flexible, sinewy quality. It writhes gently, almost as if it were seeking something...

Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key <TECHNOLOGY>Sentinel ship technologies<>.
DRONE_SHARD.name: Radiant Shard
DRONE_SHARD.subtitle: Glassy Reality Intrusion

DUSTY1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <FUEL>desert environment<>.
DUSTY1.name: Pyrite
DUSTY1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

EX_BLUE.description:

Indium is found on planets orbiting <TECHNOLOGY>blue stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>.

This Indium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

EX_BLUE.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Blue

EX_GREEN.description:

EX_PURPLE.description:

EYEBALL.description:
The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive.

Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.
EYEBALL.name: Hypnotic Eye
EYEBALL.subtitle: Horrific Sample

FARMPROD3.description:
Shatter-proof, scratch-resistant glass with a self-cleaning, UV-cured coating, for general construction use.

Refined from <STELLAR>Silicate<> powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a <TECHNOLOGY>Terrain Manipulator<>.

Can be crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Frost Crystals<> extracted from plants on <TECHNOLOGY>frozen<> worlds.
FARMPROD3.name: Glass
FARMPROD3.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FIENDCORE.description: A pulsating jellied orb, this gooey sphere is warm to the touch. Its stench triggers a primal fear in mortal beings, a deep-seated gnawing that begs you to drop it and flee.
FIENDCORE.name: Larval Core
FIENDCORE.subtitle: Monstrosity

FISHCORE.description:
A highly-pressurised fleshy orb.

One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.
FISHCORE.name: Hadal Core
FISHCORE.subtitle: Horrific Sample

The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to <FUEL>recharge mining equipment<>.
 
The <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<> will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.
FUEL1.name: Carbon
FUEL1.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element

FUEL2.description:
Advanced material, processed from regular <FUEL>carbon<> in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>.

Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a <TECHNOLOGY>Advanced Mining Laser<>.
FUEL2.name: Condensed Carbon
FUEL2.subtitle: Refined Organic Element

F_ALL_LEG_L1.description: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."
F_ALL_LEG_L1.name: Dragonfish
F_ALL_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_M1.description: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."
F_ALL_LEG_M1.name: Golden Jellyfish
F_ALL_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_S1.description: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."
F_ALL_LEG_S1.name: Singing Sea-Snail
F_ALL_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_XL.description: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."
F_ALL_LEG_XL.name: The Lunker
F_ALL_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_L1.description: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."
F_COLD_LEG_L1.name: Iceblood Gulper
F_COLD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_M1.description: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."
F_COLD_LEG_M1.name: Ghostfin
F_COLD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_S1.description: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."
F_COLD_LEG_S1.name: Crystal Jelly
F_COLD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_XL.description: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."
F_COLD_LEG_XL.name: Nautilia
F_COLD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_L1.description: "Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.name: The Hunter Below
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_M1.description: "It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.name: Brain Eel
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_S1.description: "Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.name: Sentient Crab
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_XL.description: "So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.name: Leviathan Spawn
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_L1.description: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."
F_DUST_LEG_L1.name: Ossified Deinosuchus
F_DUST_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_M1.description: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."
F_DUST_LEG_M1.name: Titanworm Larva
F_DUST_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_S1.description: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."
F_DUST_LEG_S1.name: Fragile Icthyoscale
F_DUST_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_XL.description: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."
F_DUST_LEG_XL.name: Megalodon
F_DUST_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_L1.description: "Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."
F_GAS_LEG_L1.name: Hyper-cockle
F_GAS_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_M1.description: "Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."
F_GAS_LEG_M1.name: Mother-of-Quicksilver
F_GAS_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_S1.description: "The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."
F_GAS_LEG_S1.name: Mandelbrot Worm
F_GAS_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_XL.description: "So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."
F_GAS_LEG_XL.name: The Maw of Titan
F_GAS_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_L1.description: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."
F_HOT_LEG_L1.name: Jelly of the Veil
F_HOT_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_M1.description: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."
F_HOT_LEG_M1.name: Mirrorscale Skipper
F_HOT_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_S1.description: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."
F_HOT_LEG_S1.name: Starshell Crab
F_HOT_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_XL.description: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."
F_HOT_LEG_XL.name: Ancient Irontail
F_HOT_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_L1.description: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.name: Reef Guardian
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_M1.description: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.name: Mist Serpent
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_S1.description: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.name: Glass Angel
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_XL.description: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.name: Blind Titancore
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_L1.description: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."
F_ODD_LEG_L1.name: Child of Helios
F_ODD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_M1.description: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."
F_ODD_LEG_M1.name: Atlantidian Crab
F_ODD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_S1.description: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."
F_ODD_LEG_S1.name: Abyssal Horror Egg
F_ODD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_XL.description: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."
F_ODD_LEG_XL.name: Many-Mouthed Lunker
F_ODD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_L1.description: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."
F_RAD_LEG_L1.name: Gamma Squid
F_RAD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_M1.description: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."
F_RAD_LEG_M1.name: Aberrant Duskfin
F_RAD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_S1.description: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."
F_RAD_LEG_S1.name: Many-Eyed Jellyfish
F_RAD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_XL.description: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."
F_RAD_LEG_XL.name: Helix Sawfish
F_RAD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_L1.description: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."
F_TOX_LEG_L1.name: Bleached Bonefish
F_TOX_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_M1.description: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."
F_TOX_LEG_M1.name: Vampire Squid
F_TOX_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_S1.description: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."
F_TOX_LEG_S1.name: Emeril Sunstar
F_TOX_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_XL.description: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."
F_TOX_LEG_XL.name: Translucent Gulper
F_TOX_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

GAS1.description:
A pungent atmospheric <TRADEABLE>gas<>. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life.

With the aid of <TECHNOLOGY>specialised machinery<>, can be extracted from the atmospheres of <FUEL>Scorched<> and <SPECIAL>Desert<> planets.
GAS1.name: Sulphurine
GAS1.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GAS2.description:
A colourless, odourless <TRADEABLE>gas<> with a relatively short half-life. 

Found in both <COMMODITY>Radioactive<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Frozen<> atmospheres, this gas is produced by the decay of other high-energy elements.
GAS2.name: Radon
GAS2.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GAS3.description:
A reactive atmospheric <TRADEABLE>gas<> found wherever there is organic life.

Nitrogen is readily harvested from the atmospheres of <TRADEABLE>Lush<> and <TRADEABLE>Toxic<> planets.
GAS3.name: Nitrogen
GAS3.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GAS4.description:
An atmospheric <TRADEABLE>gas<> found in the hostile conditions of <SPECIAL>gas giants<>.

Methane is readily harvested from equipment deployed on <TECHNOLOGY>gas<> worlds.
GAS4.name: Methane
GAS4.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GASGIANT1.description:
A supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of <SPECIAL>gas giants<>.
GASGIANT1.name: Crystallised Helium
GASGIANT1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

GREEN2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

Emeril is found on planets orbiting <TRADEABLE>green stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
GREEN2.name: Emeril
GREEN2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Green

GRENFUEL1.description:
Densely-packed fuel capsule for use in the <TECHNOLOGY>Plasma Launcher<>.
 
Contained highly-pressurised electro-thermal energy for use in land disruption grenade technology.
GRENFUEL1.name: Unstable Plasma
GRENFUEL1.subtitle: Plasma Launcher Recharge

HOT1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <FUEL>scorched environment<>.
HOT1.name: Phosphorus
HOT1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

HYPERFUEL1.description:
This <FUEL>antimatter-based fuel<> is one of the few power sources capable of meeting the incredible energy requirements of a <TECHNOLOGY>starship hyperdrive<>.

Secured within a robust housing, the cell is guaranteed paradox-free during FTL travel.
HYPERFUEL1.name: Warp Cell
HYPERFUEL1.subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit

JELLY.description:
A faintly-glowing jelly. Its gentle light and soft wobble belie the fact that this sticky gel is both highly toxic and highly flammable. Skin contact is to be avoided at all costs.

Synthesised from <TECHNOLOGY>Di-hydrogen<>.
JELLY.name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
JELLY.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power

LAND1.description:
An abundant mineral element, found in <EARTH>rock formations<> and other areas of geological interest. Easily extracted using a <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<>.

Typically requires processing in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> before use in construction or technology manufacture.
LAND1.name: Ferrite Dust
LAND1.subtitle: Metallic Mineral Extract

LAND2.description:
Processed metal, free of dust and pebbles. Used to construct a wide variety of <EARTH>structures<> and <TECHNOLOGY>technologies<>.

Typically purified from Ferrite dust using a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>, but can occasionally be found in large deposits. Collection may require an <TECHNOLOGY>Advanced Mining Laser<>.
LAND2.name: Pure Ferrite
LAND2.subtitle: Processed Metallic Minerals

LAND3.description:
Highly processed metal, requiring several stages of processing in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>.

Used in the creation of advanced structures and technologies. Avoid ingestion.
LAND3.name: Magnetised Ferrite
LAND3.subtitle: Charged Metallic Element

LAUNCHFUEL.description:
Highly reactive solid-state fuel, required to fuel <TECHNOLOGY>Starship Launch Thrusters<>.

Created from crystallised <TECHNOLOGY>Di-hydrogen<>, found in blue deposits on all worlds.
LAUNCHFUEL.name: Starship Launch Fuel
LAUNCHFUEL.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel

LAUNCHSUB.description:
A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures.

Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large <TECHNOLOGY>blue crystals<>. It is a key component of <COMMODITY>Starship Launch Fuel<>.
LAUNCHSUB.name: Di-hydrogen
LAUNCHSUB.subtitle: High Energy Substance

LAUNCHSUB2.description:
A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology.

Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of <TECHNOLOGY>Di-hydrogen<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Tritium<> in <TECHNOLOGY>Refiners<>.
LAUNCHSUB2.name: Deuterium
LAUNCHSUB2.subtitle: High Energy Substance

LAVA1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <FUEL>volcanic environment<>.
LAVA1.name: Basalt
LAVA1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

LUSH1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <TRADEABLE>tropical environment<>.
LUSH1.name: Paraffinium
LUSH1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

NANOTUBES.description:
Metres and metres of high capacity <FUEL>carbon nanotubes<>.

Their high tensile strength and mild conductivity make these a key component in many <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
NANOTUBES.name: Carbon Nanotubes
NANOTUBES.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

NIPNIPBUDS.description: A pungent bud harvested from the NipNip plant, often used to produce Gek Nip.
NIPNIPBUDS.name: NipNip Buds
NIPNIPBUDS.subtitle: Medicinal Substance

OXYGEN.description:
Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit <FUEL>life support system<>.

Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora.

Other plantlife may be scanned with the <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<> to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.
OXYGEN.name: Oxygen
OXYGEN.subtitle: Concentrated Liquid Fuel

PLANT_CAVE.description:
A glowing organic bulb, harvested from the <TRADEABLE>Cave Marrow plant<> found growing <TECHNOLOGY>underground<>.

The Cave Marrow has proved resistant to domestication, and no farmable cultivars are known to exist. As such, marrow bulbs must be harvested by hand in the wild.
PLANT_CAVE.name: Marrow Bulb
PLANT_CAVE.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_DUST.description:
Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the <TRADEABLE>Echinocactus plant<>. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses.

The Echinocactus thrives only on <FUEL>desert planets<>, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>..
PLANT_DUST.name: Cactus Flesh
PLANT_DUST.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_HOT.description:
A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the <TRADEABLE>Solar Vine<>.

The vine requires a <FUEL>hot climate<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_HOT.name: Solanium
PLANT_HOT.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_LUSH.description:
A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the <TRADEABLE>Star Bramble<>.

The host plant requires <TRADEABLE>lush conditions<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_LUSH.name: Star Bulb
PLANT_LUSH.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_POOP.description:
A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the <TRADEABLE>Gutrot Flower<>, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species.

Creatures can be fed to encourage the formation and deposition of faecium crystals.
PLANT_POOP.name: Faecium
PLANT_POOP.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_RADIO.description:
A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the <TRADEABLE>Gamma Weed plant<>.

Gamma Weed requires <COMMODITY>high background radiation<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_RADIO.name: Gamma Root
PLANT_RADIO.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_SNOW.description:
A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of <TRADEABLE>Frostwort<>.

Frostwort requires <TECHNOLOGY>frozen conditions<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_SNOW.name: Frost Crystal
PLANT_SNOW.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_TOXIC.description:
An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of <TRADEABLE>Fungal Clusters<>.

The host plant requires a <TRADEABLE>toxic climate<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_TOXIC.name: Fungal Mould
PLANT_TOXIC.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_WATER.description:
A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from <TECHNOLOGY>underwater<> <TRADEABLE>Candle Kelp<> plants.

Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.
PLANT_WATER.name: Kelp Sac
PLANT_WATER.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

POWERCELL.description:
Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of <COMMODITY>defensive<> and <COMMODITY>hazard protection<> systems.
 
Constructed by fusing <EARTH>Ferrite Dust<> with underground <TECHNOLOGY>Cobalt<>. Frequently found ready-made in cylindrical metal containers.
POWERCELL.name: Ion Battery
POWERCELL.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage

PRODFUEL2.description:
Emergency <FUEL>life support fuel<>.

Synthesised from <TECHNOLOGY>rocket fuel crystals<> and <FUEL>carbon<>, this gel offers a temporary boost to life support systems. Long-term impact on user's lungs is currently unknown.
PRODFUEL2.name: Life Support Gel
PRODFUEL2.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power

PURPLE2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic mineral<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Quartzite is found on planets orbiting <SPECIAL>purple stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
PURPLE2.name: Quartzite
PURPLE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Purple

RADIO1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <CATALYST>radioactive environment<>.
RADIO1.name: Uranium
RADIO1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

REACTION1.description:
A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Sulphurine<> and <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
REACTION1.name: Thermic Condensate
REACTION1.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

REACTION2.description:
A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Radon<> and <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
REACTION2.name: Enriched Carbon
REACTION2.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

REACTION3.description:
A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Nitrogen<> and <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
REACTION3.name: Nitrogen Salt
REACTION3.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

RED2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Cadmium is found on planets orbiting <FUEL>red stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
RED2.name: Cadmium
RED2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Red

ROBOT1.description:
This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of <SPECIAL>Sentinels<>.

Prized by the <FUEL>Vy'keen<>, Pugneum is thought to share some essential properties with <TECHNOLOGY>Nanites<>. It hums in a sinister fashion upon contact with organic matter.
ROBOT1.name: Pugneum
ROBOT1.subtitle: Anomalous Material

ROBOT2.description:
This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of <SPECIAL>corrupted Sentinels<> as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom.

It possesses a crystalline beauty that cannot be reconciled with the corruption from whence it flows.
ROBOT2.name: Atlantideum
ROBOT2.subtitle: Disharmonic Metal

ROCKETSUB.description: Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines<>. Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids<> using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN<>) to search for tritium-rich asteroids<>.
ROCKETSUB.name: Tritium
ROCKETSUB.subtitle: Neutron-Rich Fuel Element

RUINSUB.description:
The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand.

Acquired by applying the <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<> to the structral remnants located on <STELLAR>ruined worlds<>.
RUINSUB.name: Polished Stone
RUINSUB.subtitle: Recycled Minerals

S15_FISH.description:
Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away.

The sound of water fills your ears. It wants to be free. You want to be free...
S15_FISH.name: The Angler
S15_FISH.subtitle: Legendary Fish

SAND1.description:
An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a <TECHNOLOGY>Terrain Manipulator<>. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction.

Process in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create <TECHNOLOGY>Glass<>.
SAND1.name: Silicate Powder
SAND1.subtitle: Abundant Mineral

SHIPBRAIN.description:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies.

A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own <TECHNOLOGY>Pilot Interface<> for a Sentinel Interceptor.

Status: <FUEL>VOLATILE<>
SHIPBRAIN.name: Hyaline Brain
SHIPBRAIN.subtitle: Sentience Vessel

SPACEGUNK1.description:
A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

Skin contact is not advised.
SPACEGUNK1.name: Residual Goop
SPACEGUNK1.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK2.description:
An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

Likely to be several different species of mould, merged together into one super-colony.
SPACEGUNK2.name: Runaway Mould
SPACEGUNK2.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK3.description:
Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment.

Handle with care.
SPACEGUNK3.name: Rusted Metal
SPACEGUNK3.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK4.description:
A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own.

Nutrient source: <FUEL>unknown<>.
SPACEGUNK4.name: Living Slime
SPACEGUNK4.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK5.description:
An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom.

Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.
SPACEGUNK5.name: Viscous Fluids
SPACEGUNK5.subtitle: Junk

SPECIAL_POOP.description: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.
SPECIAL_POOP.name: Hexite
SPECIAL_POOP.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element

STELLAR2.description:
A processed metal alloy, created in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> from the <STELLAR>stellar metals<>: <COMMODITY>Copper<>, <FUEL>Cadmium<>, <TRADEABLE>Emeril<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Indium<>.

The <SPECIAL>rarer<> the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce.

This valuable metal is used in the creation of many <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
STELLAR2.name: Chromatic Metal
STELLAR2.subtitle: Highly Refined Stellar Metal

TECHFRAG.description:
A dense miasma of <TECHNOLOGY>Nanites<>, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.

Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.
TECHFRAG.name: Nanite Cluster
TECHFRAG.subtitle: Technological Currency

TOXIC1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <TRADEABLE>toxic environment<>.
TOXIC1.name: Ammonia
TOXIC1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

TRA_CURIO2.description:
Edible product much beloved by the Gek.
 
Allows beaked traders to release delightfully scented packets of gas for a prolonged period of time.
 
GekNip gas packets are considered an art form, and the truest representation of the Gek soul.
TRA_CURIO2.name: GekNip
TRA_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity

VENTGEM.description:
Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality.

Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.
VENTGEM.name: Crystal Sulphide
VENTGEM.subtitle: Compressed Mineral

WATER1.description:
A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in <TECHNOLOGY>underwater minerals<>.

Can be processed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create <TRADEABLE>Chlorine<>. This refined form is used in the manufacture of advanced products and technologies.
WATER1.name: Salt
WATER1.subtitle: Aquatic Mineral Extract

WATER2.description:
A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in <TECHNOLOGY>oceans<>.

Used in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
WATER2.name: Chlorine
WATER2.subtitle: Processed Aquatic Mineral

WATERPLANT.description:
A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies.
 
The <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<> will harvest cyto-phosphate compounds from <TECHNOLOGY>underwater flora<>.
WATERPLANT.name: Cyto-Phosphate
WATERPLANT.subtitle: Organic Compound

WATERWORLD1.description:
Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on <TECHNOLOGY>ocean planets<>.
WATERWORLD1.name: Lithium
WATERWORLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

WORMCORE.description:
The coiled remains of a <SPECIAL>Hungering Tendril<>'s digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps...

Such specialist offal is rarely traded on the Galactic Exchange and is thus <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.
WORMCORE.name: Flesh Rope
WORMCORE.subtitle: Intestinal Fragment

WORMDUST.description:
A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet.

Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by <SPECIAL>titan worm activity<>.
WORMDUST.name: Cursed Dust
WORMDUST.subtitle: Ashes of Despair

WORMPROD.description:
The fragile embryo of a <SPECIAL>Hungering Tendril<>, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched.

May be extracted from embryotic sacs with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Visceral Synthesiser<>.
WORMPROD.name: Vile Spawn
WORMPROD.subtitle: Hungering Embryo

YELLOW2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Copper is found on planets orbiting <CATALYST>yellow stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
YELLOW2.name: Copper
YELLOW2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Yellow
